packs.name: Light Ridge
packs.label: Light Ridge Pack
packs.update: The Light Ridge Pack was not documented as a breeding pair in 2025. A total of four wolves, including one pup, were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Pearson Cr
packs.label: Pearson Creek Pack
packs.update: Pearson Creek Pack was not documented as a breeding pair. A total of five wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Five Points
packs.label: Five Points Pack
packs.update: The Five Points Pack produced at least two pups that survived to the end of 2025 and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of five wolves were documented in the winter count.

packs.name: Ruckel Ridge
packs.label: Ruckel Ridge Pack
packs.update: The Ruckel Ridge Pack produced two pups that survived to the end of the year and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of six wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Jarboe
packs.label: Jarboe Pack
packs.update: New resident wolf activity was documented in northern Union County. The Jarboe Pack produced three pups that survived to the end of 2025 and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of six wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Snake River
packs.label: Snake River Pack
packs.update: New resident wolf activity was documented in eastern Wallowa County. Breeding for the first time, a new pair produced at least two pups that survived until the end of 2025. Four wolves were documented in the new Snake River Pack during the winter count.

packs.name: Wenaha
packs.label: Wenaha Pack
packs.update: The Wenaha Pack produced at least two pups that survived to the end of 2025 and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of nine wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Peavine
packs.label: Peavine Pack
packs.update: Previously named OR157 wolves in northern Wallowa County. Breeding for the first time, the Peavine Pack produced at least four pups that survived until the end of 2025. A total of six wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Kuhn Ridge
packs.label: Kuhn Ridge Pack
packs.update: The Kuhn Ridge Pack produced at least four pups that survived until the end of the year and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of eleven wolves were documented in the winter count.

packs.name: Wildcat
packs.label: Wildcat Pack
packs.update: The Wildcat Pack produced at least four pups that survived until the end of the year and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of seven wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Bear Cr
packs.label: Bear Creek wolves
packs.update: One wolf was documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Middle Fork
packs.label: Middle Fork Pack
packs.update: For the 2025 annual count, the Middle Fork Pack produced at least four pups that survived to the end of 2025 and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of eleven wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Balloon Tree
packs.label: Balloon Tree Pack
packs.update: The Balloon Tree Pack produced at least three pups that survived to the end of 2025 and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of six wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Minam
packs.label: Minam Pack
packs.update: The Minam Pack was not documented as a breeding pair. A total of four wolves were documented during the annual count.

packs.name: Keating
packs.label: Keating wolves
packs.update: The Keating Pack was not documented as a breeding pair for 2025. A total of two wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Ukiah
packs.label: Ukiah Pack
packs.update: The Ukiah Pack was documented as a breeding pair in 2026. A total of six wolves, including four pups, were documented in the winter count.

packs.name: Black Pines
packs.label: Black Pines Pack
packs.update: The Black Pines Pack produced five pups that survived to the end of 2025 and was documented as a breeding pair in 2025. A total of seven wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Logan Valley
packs.label: Logan Valley wolves
packs.update: At the end of the year, two wolves were documented in the Logan Valley pack area.

packs.name: Desolation
packs.label: Desolation Pack
packs.update: Desolation did not produce pups during 2025. At the end of the year, four wolves were documented in the winter count.

packs.name: Tower Mtn
packs.label: Tower Mtn Pack
packs.update: The Tower Mountain Pack produced at least three pups that survived to the end of 2025 and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of seven wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Bear Valley
packs.update: Two wolves documented in the Bear Valley AKWA during the winter count, and OR183 pair made frequent visits to Bear Valley AKWA.

packs.name: Interstate
packs.update: Two wolves were documented in the Interstate WMU at the end of 2025 with no reproduction detected.

packs.name: Yamsay Mtn
packs.label: Yamsay Mtn wolves
packs.update: In 2025, the Yamsay Mountain Pack did not appear to produce any pups that survived to the end of the year and was not counted as a breeding pair, with two wolves in the pack.

packs.name: Gearhart Mtn
packs.label: Gearhart Mtn Pack
packs.update: In 2025, the Gearhart Mountain Pack produced two pups that survived to the end of the year and were designated as a breeding pair, with four wolves in the pack.

packs.name: Ochoco
packs.label: Ochoco wolves
packs.update: This pair of wolves has resided in the Ochoco Mountains since late 2024.

packs.name: Arbuckle
packs.label: Arbuckle Pack
packs.update: During winter count, 6 wolves were documented in the area. The Arbuckle pack had at least two pups survive to the end of 2025, counting as a breeding pair.

packs.name: Sprague
packs.label: Sprague Pack
packs.update: In 2025, the Sprague Pack produced one pup that survived until the end of the year and was not counted as a breeding pair, with four wolves in the pack.

packs.name: Rogue
packs.label: Rogue wolves
packs.update: Wolf activity was low in the Rogue territory during 2025 with no sign of reproduction. Two wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Indigo
packs.label: Indigo Pack
packs.update: In 2025, the Indigo Pack produced one pup that survived until the end of the year and was not counted as a breeding pair, with five wolves in the pack.

packs.name: Grouse Ridge
packs.label: Grouse Ridge Pack
packs.update: In 2025, the Grouse Ridge Pack produced seven pups that survived until the end of the year and were designated as a breeding pair, with fifteen wolves in the pack.

packs.name: Upper Deschutes
packs.label: Upper Deschutes Pack
packs.update: The Upper Deschutes Pack was counted as a breeding pair, with a total of nine wolves documented at the end of 2025.

packs.name: Warm Springs
packs.label: Warm Springs Pack
packs.update: The Warm Springs Pack was counted as a breeding pair, with a total of nine wolves at the end of the year.

packs.name: White River
packs.label: White River wolves
packs.update: The White River group failed to reproduce in 2025 and consisted of three adult wolves at the end of the year, including OR165, originally from the Warm Springs Pack.

packs.name: Pinnacles
packs.label: Pinnacles Pack
packs.update: The Pinnacles Pack- A newly detected pack, producing at three pups that survived to the end of 2025. The pack was designated a breeding pair and has five members. Rogue The Rogue Pack spends part of its time in Jackson County. See Jackson County AKWA for more information.

packs.name: Hawthorn
packs.label: Hawthorn Pack
packs.update: The Hawthorn Pack reproduced for the first time in 2025; the breeding female (OR163) originated from the Warm Springs Pack, and the pack ended the year with seven wolves, including five juveniles.

packs.name: Mt Hood
packs.label: Mt Hood Pack
packs.update: The Mt Hood Pack reproduced for the first time in 2025 and ended the year with six wolves, including four surviving juveniles.

packs.name: Northside
packs.label: Northside wolves
packs.update: Three wolves were documented traveling together during the winter count. Tower Mountain The Tower Mountain wolves spend most of their time in Union County. See Union County AKWA for more information.

packs.name: Finley Ridge
packs.label: Finley Ridge Pack
packs.update: The Finley Ridge Pack was not documented as a breeding pair in 2025. A total of four wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Noregaard
packs.label: Noregaard wolves
packs.update: The Noregaard group was not documented as a breeding pair in 2025. Two wolves were documented during the winter count.

packs.name: Clark Cr
packs.label: Clark Creek Pack
packs.update: The Clark Creek Pack produced at least three pups that survived until the end of 2025 and was counted as a breeding pair. A total of six wolves were documented in the winter count.

packs.name: Metolius
packs.label: Metolius wolves
packs.update: Reproduction failed during 2025 in the Metolius Pack and the group consisted of three adult wolves at the end of the year.

notes: Madison Butte Pack (southwestern Morrow County): ODFW documented no wolves in the 2025 winter count after six were lethally removed in late 2025.
